description: This file provides common type definitions, specifically the class 'Long' which represents 64-bit integers, along with a 'LongLike' union type for various number representations. It serves as a type declaration for handling 64-bit integer operations across modules, supporting both ESM and UMD module formats.

classes.name: Long
classes.description: A class representing 64-bit signed or unsigned integers with extensive methods for arithmetic, bitwise operations, and conversions.

methods.name: Long.fromString
methods.description: Creates a Long instance from a string with specified radix.

methods.name: Long.prototype.add
methods.description: Returns a new Long representing the sum of this and another Long.

methods.name: Long.prototype.divide
methods.description: Returns a new Long representing this divided by the specified divisor.

methods.name: Long.prototype.equals
methods.description: Checks if this Long equals another Long.

methods.name: Long.prototype.gt
methods.description: Checks if this Long is greater than another Long.

methods.name: Long.prototype.greaterThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if this Long is greater than or equal to another Long.

methods.name: Long.prototype.lt
methods.description: Checks if this Long is less than another Long.

methods.name: Long.prototype.lte
methods.description: Checks if this Long is less than or equal to another Long.

methods.name: Long.prototype.multiply
methods.description: Returns a new Long representing the product of this and another Long.

methods.name: Long.prototype.negate
methods.description: Negates the value of this Long.

methods.name: Long.prototype.not
methods.description: Returns a new Long with bitwise NOT of this Long.

methods.name: Long.prototype.shl
methods.description: Shifts bits to the left by the specified amount.

methods.name: Long.prototype.shr
methods.description: Performs an arithmetic right shift.

methods.name: Long.prototype.shr_u
methods.description: Performs a logical right shift.

methods.name: Long.prototype.rotateLeft
methods.description: Rotates bits to the left.

methods.name: Long.prototype.rotateRight
methods.description: Rotates bits to the right.

methods.name: Long.prototype.subtract
methods.description: Returns a new Long representing the difference.

methods.name: Long.prototype.toBigInt
methods.description: Converts the Long to a BigInt.

methods.name: Long.prototype.toInt
methods.description: Converts the Long to a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: Long.prototype.toNumber
methods.description: Converts the Long to a JavaScript number.

methods.name: Long.prototype.toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Long in specified radix.

methods.name: Long.prototype.toUnsigned
methods.description: Converts the Long to an unsigned Long.

methods.name: constructor(low: number, high?: number, unsigned?: boolean); constructor
methods.description: unavailable
